units.source_text: 苗子站在御所门阴凉处等候秀男，人群进进出出，十分拥挤，倒也没人留意她。

en.t: Naeko stood waiting for Hideo in the shade by the palace gate. Crowds were coming and going, and it was very crowded, but no one paid her any attention.

units.source_text: 不料却有一个商店老板娘模样的中年女子，大大咧咧地走了过来，说：“小姐，您的腰带真漂亮。

en.t: Unexpectedly, a middle-aged woman who looked like a shopkeeper's wife came striding over without hesitation and said, "Miss, your obi is truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 同和服很般配……让我瞧瞧。”

en.t: It goes so well with your kimono... let me have a look."

units.source_text: 女子说着伸手去摸，“能让我看看背后的带子吗？”

en.t: As she spoke, the woman reached out to touch it. "May I see the knot at the back?"
